title: JSON in and out
hints: `new JsonStringEnumConverter(JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase)` writes `Priority.High` as `"high"`; `JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull` leaves out null values.

`JsonNode.Parse(json)` gives a tree: `node["due"]?.GetValue<string>()` is the due date text, or null when the property is missing. `DateOnly.Parse(text, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)` turns `"2026-03-01"` into a `DateOnly`, and two dates compare with `<`.
